title: Ferenc József magyar király lesz (Franz Joseph, King of Hungary)
grammar: Concessive Connectors, Purpose Clauses & Dual Constitutional Register

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say when, where and by whom Franz Joseph was crowned king of Hungary.
I can use -vá/-vé and esküt tett to describe a coronation.
I can name the Holy Crown, the coronation oath and Matthias Church in a citizenship interview.
I can read a short text about the coronation and answer questions about it.
